diagram.manim_description: Draw triangle ABC with BC horizontal at the bottom, B at the lower left, C at the lower right, A above: angle B = 50 degrees and angle C = 70 degrees (INK arcs and labels). Draw the horizontal line XY through A, parallel to BC, with a filled dot and a letter at each end (X at the left, Y at the right). In ANSWER green draw and label the three angles at A below the line: angle XAB = 50 degrees on the left, angle BAC = 60 degrees in the middle, angle YAC = 70 degrees on the right. Canvas: 1920 x 1080 px (19.2 x 10.8 canvas-cm, 1 canvas-cm = 100 px, origin at the bottom-left, y up), plain BG (#FFFFFF) background. All strokes are 3 px unless stated. All text is sans-serif, 48 px, horizontal, centred on the stated point. Draw a straight line, 3 px, in INK, from (5.000, 2.500) to (12.200, 2.500). Draw a straight line, 3 px, in INK, from (5.000, 2.500) to (10.022, 8.485). Draw a straight line, 3 px, in INK, from (12.200, 2.500) to (10.022, 8.485). Draw a straight line, 3 px, in ANSWER, from (4.822, 8.485) to (15.222, 8.485). Draw a filled dot in ANSWER of radius 0.09 at (4.822, 8.485). Draw a filled dot in ANSWER of radius 0.09 at (15.222, 8.485). At (5.000, 2.500) draw an angle arc in INK of radius 1.00 from 0.00 to 50.00 degrees (counter-clockwise, y up). At (12.200, 2.500) draw an angle arc in INK of radius 1.00 from 110.00 to 180.00 degrees (counter-clockwise, y up). At (10.022, 8.485) draw an angle arc in ANSWER of radius 1.00 from 180.00 to 230.00 degrees (counter-clockwise, y up). At (10.022, 8.485) draw an angle arc in ANSWER of radius 1.00 from 230.00 to 290.00 degrees (counter-clockwise, y up). At (10.022, 8.485) draw an angle arc in ANSWER of radius 1.00 from 290.00 to 360.00 degrees (counter-clockwise, y up). Write "50°" in INK, horizontal, 48 px sans-serif, centred at (6.578, 2.864). Write "70°" in INK, horizontal, 48 px sans-serif, centred at (11.095, 3.685). Write "60°" in ANSWER, horizontal, 48 px sans-serif, centred at (9.782, 7.126). Write "50°" in ANSWER, horizontal, 48 px sans-serif, centred at (8.463, 8.125). Write "70°" in ANSWER, horizontal, 48 px sans-serif, centred at (11.456, 7.690). Write "B" in INK, horizontal, 48 px sans-serif, centred at (4.740, 2.372). Write "C" in INK, horizontal, 48 px sans-serif, centred at (12.478, 2.322). Write "A" in INK, horizontal, 48 px sans-serif, centred at (10.022, 8.855). Write "X" in INK, horizontal, 48 px sans-serif, centred at (4.532, 8.485). Write "Y" in INK, horizontal, 48 px sans-serif, centred at (15.512, 8.485). Draw nothing else.
accuracy_checks: Angles of triangle ABC: B = 50, C = 70, A = 60 degrees (computed A 60.00, B 50.00, C 70.00).
Line XY passes through A and is horizontal, BC is horizontal: XY is parallel to BC.
Alternate angles: angle XAB = 50 degrees = angle B and angle YAC = 70 degrees = angle C; with angle BAC = 60 degrees the three angles at A make the straight angle: 50 + 60 + 70 = 180.
A lies strictly between X and Y on the line.
diagram.alt_text: Triangle ABC with a line XY through A parallel to BC; angles 50 degrees at B and 70 degrees at C, and at A the angles XAB 50, BAC 60 and YAC 70 degrees.
diagram.render_note: Book Fig. 7.6 (p.19) shows the line XY with dots at X and Y, the 50 and 70 degrees at B and C and an unlabelled arc at A; the alternate angles and the 60 degrees are added from the LP solution. The teaching image M2.S24.T24.C78.IMG1 shows the same figure and is not linked.
